question_text:
Which sentence corrects the double negative in this Makati City grievance response?

"The complainant said he couldn't find none of the required documents."

A. The complainant said he couldn't find any of the required documents.
B. The complainant said he couldn't find none of the required documents.
C. The complainant said he could find none of the required documents.
D. The complainant said he couldn't find the required documents.

options.text: The complainant said he couldn't find any of the required documents.
The complainant said he couldn't find none of the required documents.
The complainant said he could find none of the required documents.
The complainant said he couldn't find the required documents.
